title: The same index, different fees
hook: Two stated cases: explore the compounding drag of a fee difference.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the compounding drag of a fee difference affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Balance, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the compounding drag of a fee difference in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Toy principal 1000 grows at annual return 0.05 minus annual fee 0.002 for 20 years. What balance results?
